visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Return the Condition Directly
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A boolean variable is set inside three nested ifs and returned at the end. Return the condition as a single expression. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: An if that only sets a boolean to true or false can almost always be replaced by returning the condition itself. The one-line version mirrors the rule as it is written in the calendar definition.
